output.scope_note: The paper is a computational study of amorphous Na3OCl structure, but its introduction cites literature ionic conductivities for glassy Li3OCl/Na3OCl antiperovskites and an amorphous Li3OCl composite, so it is in scope only through those literature_cited values.
